preamble: Caravan Crossing (Complex): These five caravans—Aghilas, Taziri, Amastan, Itri, and Tassadit—cross the Sahara relying entirely on human runners carrying parchment slips between groups. A courier lost behind a dune, a collapsed camel, or a sudden sandstorm can silence a caravan for hours. In this crossing, Tassadit collapses early and cannot dispatch runners. A storm then reshapes the formations, isolating caravans into separate partitions that no messenger can traverse. Aghilas’s first proposal fails to gather a quorum. When the storm clears and Tassadit recovers, a fresh proposal from Itri finally propagates across the desert, allowing the group to agree on a campsite.
